subject.title: feat: validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should Crabbox expose and maintain `--require-artifact-schema` with this custom fail-closed JSON Schema subset as a public CLI contract?
rationale: The existing documented path leaves content validation to the repository command, while this PR adds a new repeatable flag, bespoke schema language, exit semantics, provider restrictions, and serialized evidence that will require long-term compatibility.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow gate
options.body: Accept the custom subset as a Crabbox contract after the trailing-content defect is fixed and real SSH-backed behavior is proven.

options.title: Keep validation repository-owned
options.body: Close the feature direction and continue requiring repository commands to validate their own evidence before Crabbox checks artifact existence.

options.title: Redesign the contract
options.body: Pause this implementation while defining a different validator, standard, or provider-capability surface with explicit upgrade guarantees.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow gate
recommendation.body: Accept the custom subset as a Crabbox contract after the trailing-content defect is fixed and real SSH-backed behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a decision about Crabbox's permanent CLI and evidence-validation scope rather than a mechanical implementation choice.
